info.title: Mailcheck Universal API
info.description: Verify email deliverability, run bulk email checks, analyze email authenticity, rotate MailCheck API keys, and inspect MailCheck account usage from the MailCheck API.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

emails[].description: Up to 100 email addresses to verify in one request. Provide a JSON array of email strings.

webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL that MailCheck should notify when bulk verification completes.

credits_remaining.description: Remaining monthly credits after the bulk verification.

cached.description: Whether the result came from cache.

catch_all.description: Whether the domain is catch-all when available.

catchAll.description: Catch-all indicator returned by the API.

has_typo_suggestion.description: Whether MailCheck found a typo suggestion.

is_disposable.description: Whether the address uses a disposable provider.

valid.description: Whether MailCheck considers the email deliverable.

unique_verified.description: Number of unique email addresses verified.
